unit.can_do_en: Can ask where something is and understand simple directions.

situation_en: Nina is shopping in a grocery store in Helsinki. She cannot find the oat milk, so she says excuse me to Ville, who works in the store, and asks where the oat milk is. Then she asks whether they have rye bread. Ville answers both questions briefly: the oat milk is over there, and yes, they have rye bread, right here. Nina says thanks.

speakers.name: Ville
speakers.role_en: a staff member stocking the shelves

speakers.name: Nina
speakers.role_en: a customer looking for two things
